EC1: Unwillingness or inability to comply with the procedures described in this protocol
EC2: Planned cardiac surgery [OR] or planned major [NOT] non-cardiac surgery within the study period.
EC3: Stroke [OR] or coronary revascularization in the past 6 months.
EC6: A diagnosis of cancer ([NOT] other than superficial squamous [OR] or basal cell skin cancer) [OR] in the past 3 years or current treatment [AND] for the active cancer.
EC7: Female of child-bearing potential who do not use adequate contraception and women who are pregnant or breast-feeding
EC8: Any clinically significant abnormality identified at the screening visit, physical examination, laboratory tests, or electrocardiogram which, in the judgment of the Investigator, would preclude safe completion of the study.
EC10: Significant renal disease [AND] manifested by serum creatinine > 2.5 mg/dL
EC11: Hepatic disease [OR] or biliary tract obstruction [OR], or significant hepatic enzyme elevation (ALT [OR] or AST > 3 times upper limit of normal).
EC12: History of intolerance to ARB [OR] or amlodipine.
EC16: Atrial fibrillation [AND] with a heart rate > 120/min.
